purpose: Pin the call-reachability state of the paths that are supposed to carry consequential effects, so a path that stops being taken fails a check instead of disappearing from view.
how_to_read: expected_state is compared against the symbol layer of implementation/tools/audit_module_usage.py.
Divergence fails in both directions: a path that was supposed to be taken and is not, and a path declared dead that has come alive without anyone updating this file.
An entry expecting anything other than entry_reachable must name what blocks it, so a known dead path stays declared rather than becoming invisible again.

entry_reachable is a weak claim. Call edges resolve by bare symbol name, so it means a chain of names reaches the symbol, not that a deployed run takes the path, and not that the call supplies real arguments. The semantic complement is the assembly and inventory tests under implementation/tests/.

paths.why: The Cockpit application factory is the assembly point for every consequential API surface. If nothing reaches it, no surface is assembled at all.

The governance check itself. Reaching it is the floor, not the goal: assembly and mutation-inventory tests separately verify that the first Knowledge write is supplied a decision client under the required posture.

The Cockpit factory now constructs the real PDP client when both MVP_POLICY_API_URL and MVP_POLICY_API_KEY are configured. Assembly tests also require an unconfigured consequential Knowledge write to fail closed by default. Entry reachability is still not a claim that a selected deployment has configured or exercised the client.

paths.blocked_by: No runtime caller wraps an effect in the generic gate helper; the first real Knowledge path binds the shared enforce_consequential seam directly so its existing persistence owner remains authoritative.
paths.why: A generic convenience wrapper is not required for the owner-specific write. Keeping its actual state explicit prevents a helper that exists only in tests from being mistaken for the application boundary.

paths.blocked_by: No runtime caller routes a capability execution through the governed path.
paths.why: Capability execution is consequential by definition. Declaring the current state keeps 'the governed path exists' from being read as 'the governed path is used'.

The first owner-specific Knowledge mutation. The Cockpit now supplies its decision client under a fail-closed default posture, while the owner binds the decision expectation to the exact signed UPDATE effect.
Admission of an external execution handoff. An admission path that is no longer reachable would silently stop being an admission path.
The other mutation entry point with a real local guard chain.
